scoring_justification: Checker recomputes nucleation quantities and heat-transfer curve from agent's raw artifacts using the paper's model and known physical constants; pointwise and structural comparisons.

outputs.description: Critical nucleus radius (meters) and required undercooling (Kelvin) for steam condensation at 100 °C.
Heat transfer coefficient α_m (W/(m²·K)) as a function of temperature difference ΔT (K).

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes the nucleation quantities and α_m(ΔT) using the same theoretical model. For nucleation: comparison of critical radius and undercooling against recomputed values. For heat transfer: comparison of α_m at each ΔT point and verification of the qualitative trend (peak location).

steps.description: Verify critical radius and undercooling within 20% of paper-reported approximate values (r_crit~1e-9, undercooling~3K).
Recompute α_m(ΔT) using the paper's model and agent's undercooling from nucleation.csv; compare pointwise (10% tol) and check peak ΔT in 2-4 K.
